name: FangDa Carbon New Material Co.,Ltd
summary: FangDa Carbon New Material Co.,Ltd engages in the research and development, production, and sale of carbon products in China and internationally. It offers general power, high power, and ultra-high power graphite electrodes. The company also provides spectral charcoal rod, solid carbon felt, high temperature carbon felt, flat carbon felt, cylindrical carbon felt, ultrafine graphite powder, isotropic graphite, and fluorocarbon board; and low ash carbon bricks, ordinary cathode carbon block, and aluminum cathode paste, as well as carbon new materials. FangDa Carbon New Material Co.,Ltd was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Lanzhou, China.
